title: Map Pathfinder Validation
description: Validate map reachability rules. THE VERDICT ONLY COVERS RULE 1: map_pathfinder has one ERROR rule (no walkable floor); rules 2-6 are WARN, are excluded from the issue count, and do not touch the exit code. Read the printed lines, not the OK.

nodes.label: Read the WARN lines — do not read the verdict
nodes.detail: map_pathfinder.py:1079 counts ERRORs only (total_issues += len(errors)); :1120 prints that count as '(N issues)'; :1122 exits 0 unless an ERROR fired. Measured 2026-08-31 at HEAD 5d7bb58a5: `check --all --verbose` = 989 maps, '989 OK, 0 FAIL (0 issues)', exit 0, over 683 WARN lines in 300 maps. Of the 231 spine maps, 109 print a WARN and 77 have their EXIT teleport flagged (Rule 2 no catch row / Rule 3 not walkable from spawn). Tutorial_Single prints both and is called OK. Grep the output for '[WARN]' and judge each line yourself: some are benign (flight/transport maps skip Rule 3/5 by design), and the tool cannot tell you which — that is prop-046.

nodes.label: Read violation details
nodes.detail: Common: spawn missing, teleporter unreachable, artifact on island, teleporter not on void.

nodes.label: Fix: add spawn point (sp)
nodes.detail: Place 'sp' in utilities layer at a floor cell.

nodes.label: Fix: add ramp or transport cube
nodes.detail: Connect unreachable area with 'r' (ramp) or 'tc' (transport cube) in utilities.

nodes.label: Fix: teleporter placement
nodes.detail: Teleporter must stand on void (height 0) with floor behind it in +z direction.

nodes.label: Is this WARN benign for THIS map?
nodes.detail: Benign: Rule 3/5 on a map traversed by flight or transport cube. NOT benign: the only exit unreachable on foot, or an artifact the lesson needs on an island. Nothing in the tool records which maps are allowed to skip a rule, so the judgement is yours and is not persisted.

summary: Run pathfinder, then READ THE WARN LINES — the OK verdict and exit 0 cover Rule 1 only. 989/989 maps pass while printing 683 warnings; 77 spine maps have a flagged exit.
